limitations: Only external visible surfaces are shown; internal cavities and hidden faces are not assessed.
No high-magnification views are provided, so very shallow or tiny marks could be below detectable resolution.
Lighting on curved matte surfaces can mimic faint streaks; subtle marks cannot be reliably distinguished from reflections or molding texture.
